source: NASA FIRMS — Fire Information for Resource Management System
name: NASA FIRMS — Fire Information for Resource Management System
scheduleDescription: Scheduled approximately every 60 minutes via GitHub Actions. Actual workflow start may be delayed.
provides: Near-real-time satellite active-fire / thermal hotspot detections (MODIS and VIIRS) for the past 7 days, with detection time, sensor, confidence and fire radiative power.
coverage: Global land areas observed by the satellites. Each location is observed only a few times per day.
coverageLimitations: Detections are thermal anomalies, not confirmed wildfires: they can include agricultural burning, industrial heat sources, gas flares, volcanic activity or other hot surfaces. Clouds, smoke and satellite overpass timing cause gaps. Near-real-time data is typically available within about 3 hours of observation, but this varies by product.
licenseOrAttribution: NASA FIRMS data courtesy of NASA's Land, Atmosphere Near real-time Capability for EOS (LANCE). NASA data is openly available; please acknowledge NASA FIRMS.
requiresSecret: FIRMS_MAP_KEY (optional; if absent the project uses the public FIRMS active-fire text files)
